$comment: Deck slides at 1920x1080, each one of the brand image tool's layouts (brand/assets/image.json) or the CLI's quote, set at slide size. Slots are the copy each slide takes, with the sample copy --sample fills; a slide draws only what it is given, and unknown slots are errors. Sources: agd-playground src/components/opencommerce-og/draw.ts, and the site's sections (a 44px heading over a 64 percent ink line, windows as the card). Slides with layout "blocks" are the compose blocks on the 12 by 12 grid (src/assets/blocks.ts), each block's slots drawn from the slide's slots. An image grid is left out: a slide takes one picture.
